home.about_text: Keola Kumaneko hosts French-language streams without a microphone, but full of expressions, animations and reactions. Between solo adventures, community games and quieter moments, she meets the people she calls 'my little spirits'.

profile.title: No microphone, plenty of personality.
profile.games_text: From solo adventures to games with her little spirits, Keola likes to mix things up. Conversations and cooking or craft videos also find a place around the games.

origin.title: The night of the blue spirits
origin.p1: A very long time ago, humans discovered the existence of beings called 'Red Pandas'.
origin.p2: Known for their fur or their cute sides, they became objects of desire for many people, such as poachers or wealthy members of the bourgeoisie who wanted to show their riches by publicly exhibiting these Red Pandas to display their power before the common people.
origin.p3: Their kind becoming increasingly rare over the years, certain organizations and important families decided to act by creating a temple that would serve as a sanctuary for these little beings, for their protection and for their preservation!
origin.p4: But what could possibly have driven humans, originally so greedy and so full of themselves, to work for such a cause?
origin.p5: All this goes back a quarter of a century, when the oldest red panda in the world was taking its last breath during a ritual of purification and assistance in passing to a better world, something unusual happened!
origin.p6: Blue flames appeared during the ritual, first taking the form of little will-o'-the-wisps, then their silhouettes gradually changed to take on the appearance of a red panda, as if the spirits of the departed had come to accompany their oldest representative at its end…

inheritance.title: An unexpected inheritance
inheritance.p1: A dazzling light then burst forth and rose toward the star-filled night sky and crossed the heavens like a shooting star travelling quickly around the Earth, finally ending its journey in a human home.
inheritance.p2: That very home belonged to a rather noble family named Kumaneko, but the family was doing rather badly because their only heiress was dying...
inheritance.p3: It was then that a sparkling blue flash appeared in the room where the family's heiress was, and once the light had dissipated, a mark like a seal had appeared on her stomach! But what could this possibly be?
inheritance.p4: The humans did not understand at first, it was only after the night had risen and the heiress had been miraculously cured that everything made sense, ears and a red panda tail had appeared as if by magic, as if a spirit had taken possession of this child's body, but the family could only be grateful because this had saved her life.
inheritance.p5: From then on this family drastically changed the treatment of red pandas, and as a way of thanking this strange, fortunate event, they decided to create an entire nature reserve dedicated to their protection on the heiress's orders, without trying to understand her objective, they complied as if hypnotized by a very powerful spell.

guardian.title: The temple's guardian
guardian.p1: This inheritance was passed down through the generations from mother to daughter for several centuries until the present day, over time the family had lost much of its stature through the ages with the investment put into the nature reserve protected by Kumaneko Temple.
guardian.p2: The family's riches had dwindled little by little as the generations went by, and the impact was also felt on the nature reserve that was Kumaneko Temple, so the current matriarch named Keola Kumaneko decided to change her strategy to preserve this haven of peace and protect all the red pandas living there!
guardian.p3: Although she was affected by mutism following an accident when she was younger, this had not weakened Keola while she already had the heavy responsibility of her family and the temple to manage, on the contrary it had only strengthened her convictions to make it a more secure and friendlier place for all those of her species!
guardian.p4: Her species? Oh yes, I may have forgotten to mention it, but as generations inherited the special powers of the red panda sharing the soul of all the heirs of the Kumaneko family, the spirit gained more and more control because its memory remained intact and its hold over its host was then stronger with each reincarnation into a child of that family.
guardian.p5: Then, having reached 2023, Keola Kumaneko was the personality of the female red panda residing in her host's body and, having taken complete possession of it, reaching a certain form of immortality that also applied to her host's body, which seemed to freeze its appearance despite the passing times.

streaming.title: A new kind of magic: streaming
streaming.p1: Having become aware of this, Keola, having lived for several centuries observing humans and their greedy, grasping and contemptible methods, then studied in great detail the means at her disposal to adapt, rally people to her cause and replenish Kumaneko Temple's treasury, so she could give the nature reserve a fresh start as well as a new life to improve the lives of the red pandas residing there.
streaming.p2: Taking all this into account, Keola had everything necessary bought to start streaming on a video-game entertainment platform named 'Twitch', learning the conventions of hosting an entertaining show and combining her red panda spirit magic, she created a magical bubble allowing her to be heard by her viewers while displaying what she said in those same magical bubbles.
streaming.p3: To this day she has managed to surround herself with other people in this video-game world that is streaming, and thanks to their help, her wisdom and her efforts, Kumaneko Temple is gradually coming back to life and the red pandas' habitat is being restored and beautified thanks to donations from the faithful joining Kumaneko Temple thanks to Keola's broadcasts on the Internet.
